title: Gary Glitter denies child sexual abuse charges in UK court
summary: Musician Gary Glitter appeared in a UK court and pleaded not guilty to historical child sexual abuse charges. The charges reportedly involve an eight-year-old girl. Glitter, whose real name is Paul Gadd, denied the allegations.
summary_points: Gary Glitter appeared in a UK court.
He pleaded not guilty to historical child sexual abuse charges.
The charges reportedly relate to an eight-year-old girl.
Glitter's real name is Paul Gadd.
